::: {.hero-text}
# Welcome to Demonax {.mt-1}

### A homage to an old school version of that MMORPG named after a bone, with a twist!

- **Free to play** - All accounts receive free premium, forever.
- **New creatures** - Face a wide range of new creatures, including bosses
- **New quests and areas** - Embark on new adventures with exciting new quests and areas to explore
- **New spells** - Multiple instant spells and runes takes your hunting to a new level 
- **Enhanced gameplay** - Higher rates, bestiary, achievements, and much more!

::: {.grid .gap-3 .pb-3 .pt-4}

::: {.feature}
### Enjoy enhanced gameplay
Updated graphiscs, new outfits, a bestiary, harvesting mechanics, a questlog, and achievements. Advance faster with higher skillrates and more experience. Train on dedicated creatures, idle 24/7!

::: {.learn-more}
[Learn more »](qmd/about.qmd)
:::
:::

::: {.feature}
### New adventures await
Old areas have been expanded and completely new continents have been added, both inhabited by new creatures and new bosses. Enjoy the classic old quests and go on new adventures!

::: {.learn-more}
[Learn more »](/map/index.html)
:::
:::

::: {.feature}
### Receive a weekly present
No more time for the grind? Don't worry, all characters receive a weekly present every Friday. A small token of appreciation that makes sure your week ends with successfull hunt!

::: {.learn-more}
[Learn more »](qmd/about.qmd)
:::
:::

::: {.feature}
### Today's boosted creature
Boosted creatures give 4x experience and have 2x loot chance. What are you wating for? get out there!
